_why: `go test ./...` exits 0 when it ran nothing, a non-verbose run prints nothing for a skipped test, and a
whole-suite floor does not notice one small package being emptied inside a large one's headroom (vizra-core
PR#6 VERIFY FINDING 3, PR#9 VERIFY FINDING 7). These floors are what make each of those red in the
`test-noskip` lane, which runs the suite WITHOUT make (.github/pinned-steps.yml) and judges it with
scripts/go-test-report.py. They are a FLOOR, not an expected count: they catch a suite being emptied or a
EVERY package carries a floor, and a package that runs tests with no floor is refused, so a new package
cannot arrive unprotected. There is NO skip allowlist: go-test-report.py refuses a non-empty allowed_skips,
because a required test that is skipped is not a pass (AGENTS.md, Q-001).
MEASURED on this branch before its first push (darwin/arm64, go1.26.2 host toolchain; CI runs go1.27.1 on
Generated with `--emit-floors`: 15% headroom, at least 2 tests of slack, never below 1.
